```sql
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.points), 0)
   FROM results r
   JOIN races ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
   JOIN drivers d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
   JOIN points_scheme ps ON r."positionOrder" = ps."position" AND ps."scheme_id" = 'PS2010'
   WHERE d."driverRef" = 'button' AND ra."year" = 2010)
  -
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.points), 0)
   FROM results r
   JOIN races ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
   JOIN drivers d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
   JOIN points_scheme ps ON r."positionOrder" = ps."position" AND ps."scheme_id" = 'PS2010'
   WHERE d."driverRef" = 'button' AND ra."year" = 2009)
AS points_delta;
```
